questions.q: After three years, whom did Paul go up to Jerusalem to visit?
questions.evidence: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days

questions.q: Where did Paul resist Peter to his face?
questions.evidence: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned

questions.q: In Christ Jesus, Paul says, there is neither Jew nor Greek, for all are what?
questions.evidence: for you are all one in Christ Jesus

questions.q: What does Paul call love, joy, peace, patience and the rest?
questions.evidence: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith, gentleness, and self-control

questions.q: Whatever a man sows, Paul says, that he will also do what?
questions.evidence: God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap
